BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: BARCH   SEMESTER: IX/ADD
BRANCH: ARCH   SESSION : MO/2019

SUBJECT : AR9301 PROFESSIONAL PRACTICE AND TENDERING PROCESS

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Q1 (a) Explain the system of formation of the council for “The Indian Institute of Architects”. [2]
 (b) Discuss on the necessity of various outreach programme thus conducted by the IIA. [3]

Q2 (a) What  do  you  understand  by  the  term  “Registered  Architect”? And explain  on  the
necessity of registration in the architectural profession.
[2]
 (b) Critically compare the role of COA and IIA in the field of architectural profession. [3]

Q3  Write a short note on any two of the following:
a) Professional Body  b) Project Brief  c) Professional Negligence
[2.5x2]

Q4 (a) Briefly explain on the responsibilities of an architect in “Execution of the assignment’. [2]
 (b) Discuss on the basic logic on arriving the “Schedule of Payments” suggested by COA for
various projects, with suitable example.
[3]

Q5  Write a short note on any two of the following:
a) Reimbursable Expenses  b) Indemnification c) Social Responsibility
[2.5x2]

Q6 (a) List out the “Scope of Work” of an Architect for any architectural project, along with its
allied fields.
[2]
 (b) List out with suitable explanation on the stage-wise “Schedule of Services” an architect
has to offer.
[3]

BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: B.ARCH   SEMESTER: IX/ADD.
BRANCH: ARCHITECTURE   SESSION : MO/2018

SUBJECT : AR9301 PROFESSIONAL PRACTICE AND TENDERING PROCESS

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Q1 (a) Briefly discuss the objectives of the Indian Institute of Architects (IIA).  [2]
 (b) What are the different categories of membership of the Indian Institutes of Architects.
Discuss any one in detail.
[3]

Q2 (a) What is the legal status of the Indian institute of Architects. Where is its headquarter
located?
[2]
 (b) Differentiate between the role of the Indian Institute of Architects and the Council of
Architecture?
[3]

Q3 (a) Write briefly about the Architect’s Act of 1972 and state its purpose. [2]
 (b) Write a short note on the composition of COA’s Council Members.  [3]

Q4 (a) What is the scale of charges as per COA guideline for any Housing Project?  [2]
 (b) As per the scope of work and schedule of services, discuss the services rendered by an
architect from stages 5-7.
[3]

Q5 (a) What is Retainer?  [2]
 (b) What is the professional liability of an architect and the ethics of his profession in relation
to his client and co-professionals.
[3]

Q6 (a) What do you understand by copyright of an Architect in relation to any of his design and
drawings. What are the liabilities of the client in this regard.
[2]
 (b) Briefly discuss the provisions of the ‘ARCHITECTS (PROFESSIONAL CONDUCT)
REGULATIONS, 1989’ related to an Architects’ advertisement of his services.
[3]
